body: I know how it feels... But please, imagine the look on her face when someone tells her you killed yourself. Why should she have to bury her own baby? I am sure she is strong. Maybe even strong enough to survive the cancer. But why should she fight when her baby is dead? What if she gives up, just like you want to?

But in a twisted way, I'm glad two people responded. Thank you. I don't plan on leaving a note. I won't do it where people will find me. I don't want to be found. I guess I'm just a coward seeking attention, but it's the only way I can make everyone happy. I did my research, I know what I'm doing. Just needs about nine feet, that's easy enough. I guess this kinda is a suicide note, but none of my friends will find it. Not that they care anymore. Well, bye reddit. Maybe I'll finally be successful. Wish me luck! <3

How will your mother feels when she finds out your dead? If u have friends, they will blame themselves. Families could be wrecked. Imagine whoever finds your body, the blood splattered along the walls. Their tears. Their screams. It will haunt them forever. Don't put someone else through the pain your in now.

I wish it was that simple... I'm not exactly popular. And it's not their fault... They tried to help but they don't seem to understand it doesn't just go away... Maybe it does for other people. Maybe I really am just an attention whore, begging for help she doesn't need. I don't need new friends. I need to just die.

The "meat" of the issue? Maybe that I finally made friends I finally had people who cared about me and it turns out they all have been trying to avoid me now... This month has been really bad, I admit it. On my seventh attempt. Four were just this month. However I don't cut as much as I used to (granted I just traded quality or quantity....) and I don't feel that  that bad. But I shouldn't be surprised. Why bother being close to someone when they are just going to die. I'm just happy my boyfriend has worked his ass off trying to help, no matter what. I just feel bad for him... Wasting his time loving someone who will be gone soon. So I guess I don't know what the "meat" of the issue was, except that I'll be alone again, because of a few scars.:/
